Descriptions.ShortDescription: Experimental PSF Guard Director with bounded local target scheduling.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Experimental Director with shared-core target priorities and Moon avoidance inside bounded allocations. Supports commissioned automatic workload requests and local execution during coordinator outages. Requires NINA safety monitoring and sequence-owned centering, focus, guiding, dithering and meridian flips. Automatic equipment defaults and restart/resume are not yet available. Director is separate from PSF Guard Sync and does not replace or change Sync.
